text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down 2.1% over the past day, suggesting a mild pullback from recent strength rather than panic selling. The Fear & Greed index remains in greed territory at 74 with a slight upward bias, indicating participants still expect further gains despite the dip. Bitcoin dominance holding steady at 59.2% and solid 24-hour volume of $104B reflect a market consolidating rather than retreating.
